run_port_server: run a threaded HTTP server on a specified port to manage TCP port allocation for unit tests
allocate_port_via_http: send a GET request to /get on the port server to allocate a new available TCP port
drop_port_via_http: send a GET request to /drop/PORT on the port server to release a previously allocated port back to the pool
check_port_server_version: send a GET request to /version_number on the port server to retrieve the current server version number
dump_port_pool_state: send a GET request to /dump on the port server to get a YAML dump of available and in-use ports
